title: [main] Trial Balance (Excel) report shows incorrect figures and formatting differences compared to Trial Balance (Obsolete) report in Business Central v28.2
summary: Trial Balance Excel reports now correctly apply Global Dimension filters when generating figures, fixing an issue where department filters were ignored and aggregated data included excluded dimensions.
key_points: Global Dimension 1 and 2 filters from G/L Account are now read and passed through the data collection codeunit
Dimension filters are applied via SetFilter on query columns for both ending date and opening balance calculations
Dimension filters added to RequestFilterFields to match the obsolete report behavior
Fixes incorrect totals when department filters are combined with date filters
Applies to standard, budget, and consolidated Trial Balance Excel reports using the query-based path
quote: The Excel report collects its data through codeunit 4410 "Trial Balance", which builds figures from the aggregation queries
